sources.title: Structured interview source containing the house-robber prompt
Deterministic, exhaustive and randomized house-robber validation program

claims.text: The preserved source only says 算法：打家劫舍; the linear layout, int-array input, long return type, skip-all permission, negative-value behavior and null/empty behavior are explicit candidate contracts rather than preserved source wording.
Under the explicit linear non-adjacent-selection contract, each prefix optimum is the maximum of skipping the current house and taking it together with the optimum two positions back.

The checked-in writer validation is designed to compare the exact candidate recurrence against independent non-adjacent subset brute force on deterministic, exhaustive small-domain and seeded randomized cases, including negative values and int-to-long accumulation.
